title: 第1章 鸢尾花女子监狱第2章 所以你们穿越者就是奇葩
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
马车行驶，齿轮转动，街边的摊贩在不断推销着那些不知是真是假的魔药，也偶尔有穿着魔法袍样式衣服的人悄悄从怀里摸出一把匕首，但很快又会被巡逻的骑士与修士带走。
与许多地方一样，在这座名为“水晶城”的城市中，穷人在挣扎，富人在享乐，孩童在啼哭，诗人在吟唱，贵族在佩戴宝石，平民在缝补粗布.......
而在这样一座可以称之为普通的城市中，一座看似普通的监狱，平静的风吹拂而过，阳光也轻柔洒落，一切都——————
“典狱长！！！有个犯人上厕所去偷吃粪便的时候被噎住，现在休克了！！！”
随着一名女性狱卒大喊着跑向挂着【典狱长室】的房间，这办公室内本来表情就很不爽的紫发青年默然的抬起了头，仿佛神明雕琢的俊秀脸庞上此刻只能看到阴云密布。
随着办公室大门被推开，狱卒也慌乱的看向坐在办公桌后的青年：“狄曼列典狱长！！！那个叫鲁尔克的犯人，她，她吃.......”
“可以了，我听见了”
似真似幻的清灵声音响起，被狱卒叫作狄曼列的青年默默将手中的钢笔捏断，无比疲惫的叹了口气，缓缓闭上了自己幽蓝色的眼睛：“这么多年，我还是受不了这个世界的物种多样性”
说着，狄曼列站起了身，重新睁开的眼睛也因为疲惫而闪烁着金色的魔法符文：“偏偏赫尔莎今天还休假.......”
嘴里念叨着，他随手拿起了身边一根似乎是长杖的东西，但在上面却没有看见任何作为施法媒介的水晶或者刀刃
比起武器，它更像是一根用来支撑伤员行走的拐杖
狄曼列看了一眼窗外，将这座监狱的景色全部收入眼底，尽管这些全是围墙、犯人和少数的狱警
【鸢尾花监狱】，水晶城的三座监狱之一，也是唯一的女子监狱，其中关押的罪犯自然都是女性
而这座监狱能看到的唯一男性，也只有这位青年模样的典狱长，狄曼列
至于他为什么会担任女子监狱的典狱长，那自然不是因为这里的美女多
毕竟虽然大部分犯人的颜值都很高，但除了刚刚那个在厕所里加餐的奇葩，这里还关押着各种各样，款式不同的危险人物
大魔女，高等精灵，黑暗精灵，魅魔，半人马，兽人，亡灵法师，巫妖，堕落骑士，吸血鬼.......
光是这里犯人的种族数量，就已经足够写满不止一张纸了，更别提她们所犯下的罪也是各不相同
故意杀人，玩弄灵魂，毁坏山脉，残害幼童，邪恶献祭，大规模投毒。这些足以在其他地方被千刀万剐的罪行，放在这所监狱，反倒是稀松平常了，甚至可以说是最轻的那一档
当这么多堪比天灾的犯人聚集在这里，后果可想而知

虽然有很多犯人的外表真的足以魅惑神明，亦或者令恶魔怜惜，而狄曼列看着她们试图诱惑自己的语言和动作，内心偶尔也会有一丝波动
只是往往没等这一丝波动继续扩散，它就已经化为了纯粹的杀意.......
在这里，没人知道下一秒会发生什么让人难以吐槽的事件，刚才狱警报告的“厕所进食”甚至只能算小打小闹
这也导致整个监狱关押了上千名犯人，但狱卒却只有百人不到，时不时还有人承受不住而离开
至于刚刚狄曼列提到的赫尔莎，则是这座鸢尾花监狱的副典狱长
办事利落，能力全面，无私奉献，自愿加班，要的工资还特别低，这让狄曼列一直对她很满意，放心的将监狱中大部分事情交给她
然而就是这么近乎完美的工具人，却在三天前递交了请假申请，而且足足一个月的假期
虽然狄曼列当时很想把这份申请驳回，但看着赫尔莎那漂亮脸庞上的疲惫和黑眼圈，他还是同意了这份申请
也正是因为一时的心软，如今监狱内的管理人员其实只剩下了狄曼列一个
忧愁的收回目光，狄曼列转身拍了拍这名新入职狱警的肩膀：“回去吧，我来处理”
狱警行了个礼，转身离开了这间办公室：“是！”
狄曼列掏出口袋中的灰色怀表看了一眼，拿过了桌上的预算报表：“又没钱了，这些花钱大手大脚的家伙”
说着，狄曼列也走出了这间办公室，手中的预算报表也被他收进怀里，只是预算表的抬头，却并不是鸢尾花监狱
.......
.......
监狱广场上
“典狱长来了吗？鲁尔克的呼吸越来越弱了！”
一名看上去是老员工的狱警向身后呼喊着，有些无助的看着地面上的壮硕人形
content_en:
The carriage was driving, the gears were turning, and street vendors were constantly selling potions that were unknown to be real or fake. Occasionally, someone wearing magic robe-like clothes would quietly take out a dagger from his arms, but he would soon be taken away by patrolling knights and monks.
Like many places, in this city called "Crystal City", the poor are struggling, the rich are enjoying themselves, children are crying, poets are singing, nobles are wearing gems, and common people are sewing coarse cloth...
And in such an ordinary city, a seemingly ordinary prison, the calm wind blows by, the sun shines softly, everything is...
"Warden!!! A prisoner choked when he went to the toilet to eat feces and is now in shock!!!"
As a female jailer yelled and ran towards the room where the [Warden's Room] was hung, the purple-haired young man in the office who was already looking very unhappy silently raised his head, and all he could see on his handsome face that seemed to have been carved by a god was a dark cloud.
As the office door was pushed open, the jailer looked at the young man sitting behind the desk in panic: "Warden Dimanlie!!! That prisoner named Rourke, she, she eats..."
"Okay, I heard you"
The clear voice that seemed to be real and illusory sounded. The young man named Dimanlie by the jailer silently pinched the pen in his hand, sighed extremely tiredly, and slowly closed his blue eyes: "After all these years, I still can't stand the diversity of species in this world."
As he said that, Diamanlie stood up, and his eyes that he reopened flashed with golden magic runes because of fatigue: "It just so happens that Helsa is still on vacation today..."
As he muttered, he picked up what seemed to be a long staff beside him, but he didn't see any crystals or blades on it as a medium for casting spells.
It is more like a crutch used to support the wounded than a weapon.
Diamanlie glanced out the window and took in all the scenery of the prison, even though it was all walls, prisoners and a few guards.
[Iris Prison], one of the three prisons in Crystal City, is also the only women's prison. Naturally, all the criminals imprisoned in it are women.
And the only male that can be seen in this prison is the young warden, Diamanlie.
As for why he serves as the warden of a women's prison, it's certainly not because there are so many beauties here.
After all, although most of the prisoners are very good-looking, except for the weirdo who just had extra food in the toilet, there are also various dangerous people of different styles imprisoned here.
Archwitch, high elf, dark elf, succubus, centaur, orc, necromancer, lich, fallen knight, vampire...
The number of races of the prisoners here alone is enough to fill more than one piece of paper, not to mention the different crimes they committed.
Intentional killing, playing with souls, destroying mountains, mutilating young children, evil sacrifices, and large-scale poisoning. These crimes, which would be punishable by a thousand cuts in other places, are quite common in this prison. They can even be said to be in the lightest category.
When so many prisoners who are worthy of a natural disaster gather here, the consequences can be imagined.
Although there are many prisoners whose appearance is really enough to charm the gods or make the devil pity him, Diamanlie watches their words and actions that try to seduce him, and occasionally there will be a slight fluctuation in his heart.
But often before this wave of fluctuation continues to spread, it has already turned into pure murderous intent...
Here, no one knows what unspeakable incident will happen in the next second. The "toilet eating" reported by the prison guard just now can only be regarded as a small incident.
This also resulted in the entire prison holding thousands of prisoners, but there were only less than a hundred jailors. From time to time, some people could not bear it anymore and left.
As for the Helsa mentioned by Dimanlie just now, it is thisDeputy Warden of Iris Prison
Dimanlie has always been very satisfied with her because of her neat work, comprehensive abilities, selfless dedication, voluntary overtime work, and a very low salary. She can safely leave most of the things in the prison to her.
However, such a nearly perfect tool person submitted his leave application three days ago, and he had a full month's leave.
Although Diamanlie wanted to reject the application at the time, looking at the fatigue and dark circles on Helsa's beautiful face, he still agreed to the application.
It is precisely because of a moment of soft-heartedness that the only manager in the prison now is Di Manlie.
Dimanlie looked away sadly, turned around and patted the new prison guard on the shoulder: "Go back, I will handle it."
The prison guard saluted, turned and left the office: "Yes!"
Dimanlie took out the gray pocket watch in his pocket, took a look at it, and took the budget report on the table: "We have no money again, these guys who spend money lavishly."
With that said, Dimanlie also walked out of the office, and the budget statement in his hand was also put into his arms. It was just the header of the budget statement, but it was not the Iris Prison.
.......
.......
On the prison square
"Is the warden here? Rourke's breathing is getting weaker and weaker!"
A prison guard who looked like an old employee shouted behind him, looking helplessly at the strong human figure on the ground.
